sw_blunderdog.prompt: Edit the attached ORIGINAL cartoon standee. Preserve exactly its face/species, costume, palette, thick irregular black line style, colored outer die-cut border, and full-body upright token concept. IMPORTANT: current silhouette is TOO THIN (about 1:3). Repose naturally to make the CHARACTER'S tightly cropped silhouette about 1:2 width:height, not just the canvas. Preserve full head and feet, original clothing and identity. Single character, genuine transparent background, no ground/shadow/text/card frame. Keep a thin continuous colored outer border about 2px at a 238px-high export.
